scope.summary: Implement the viseme track ingest hook (spec 13.23; AREQ-009/010): an editable VisemeTrack timeline TYPE (time-stamped viseme ids, weights, co-articulation blend params) mapped to ARKit mouth shapes with reserved non-speech moan/gasp ids, accepting externally generated tracks (Audio2Face-class JSON) - the audio lip-sync solver itself is explicitly DEFERRED as a typed stub plus contract only.
acceptance_criteria: VisemeTrack type: editable timeline of time-stamped viseme id + weight + co-articulation blend params, with the documented viseme set mapped to ARKit mouth shapes; schemars derived and persisted via the dated additive migration (AREQ-009).
Layering: a viseme track composes with arousal expressions, and moan/gasp non-speech presets hold reserved ids in the viseme set (AREQ-010).

The audio lip-sync solver is explicitly DEFERRED: a typed stub returns a structured not-implemented result carrying the recorded deferral reason; the deferral is documented in code and the user manual (blueprint contract-only scope).
Ingest path accepts externally generated viseme tracks as JSON so Audio2Face-class outputs can drive faces today.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without a typed viseme track now, lip-sync data has no landing surface and the deferred-solver decision silently becomes a design blocker for every animation MT; an unrecorded deferral would also hide the scope cut the blueprint explicitly requires recording.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit face, expressions, and speech

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Integrate production oral and ocular assets, rigging, materials, close-up expression/pose, and export validation.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
